storyCards.headline: Issues: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Julia Michaels's "Issues" reached #11 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Issues" is the debut single recorded by American singer and songwriter Julia Michaels, from her third EP, Nervous System (2017).

The song peaked at #11 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 29 weeks on the chart.

Issues was released in 2017.
